faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Guest Teacher posts is 28 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the office by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Guest Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for these positions is that candidates must be retired teachers. Specific subject-wise qualifications might be detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Teacher role?
faq.answer: There are a total of 61 vacancies for the Guest Teacher positions advertised by the District Education Office Boudh.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Guest Teacher posts will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 12,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to these Guest Teacher posts is 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the Guest Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The application process for the Guest Teacher positions is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Guest Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an application review and document verification. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for further details.

faq.question: Q9. Which subjects have vacancies for Guest Teachers?
faq.answer: Vacancies are available for TGT (ARTS), TGT (PCM), TGT (CBZ), HINDI, CLS. TR., and PET posts.
